text: Biomedical Engineering (BME) is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates biology, medicine and engineering, aiming to solve practical problems in medical diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation and health management through engineering and technical means. The course is based on "Principles of Life Sciences" and uses "Engineering Technology Methods" as a tool to cultivate students' abilities in designing medical equipment, developing biomaterials, analyzing biological signals and optimizing clinical processes. The goal is to produce compound innovative talents with both medical knowledge and engineering thinking.
